claims.claim: Changes are confined to authorized test-harness files, introduce no skips, xfails, deselection, parallelism, persistent cache, timeout changes, or production semantic changes, and preserve existing test identities.
Equivalent Git baselines are constructed once in an ephemeral process-local cache and subsequently materialized without repeating Git initialization, baseline commit creation, or initial publication.

Each materialization copies complete repository and bare-remote trees and binds an independent absolute origin, preserving isolated writable worktrees, indexes, refs, configuration, remote refs, locks, and Runtime state.
Adopted constructors continue to provide real local Git repositories and real bare remotes; bespoke topology-building logic remains unchanged after baseline materialization.
